facts: This paper shows that identifying the source language of medium-length speeches in the EUROPARL corpus is very often possible.
Identifying the source language of medium-length speeches in the EUROPARL corpus is based on frequency counts of word n-grams.
The identification accuracy depends on the classification method.
The paper examines in detail which positive markers are most powerful.
The paper identifies a number of linguistic aspects.
There are medium-length speeches in the EUROPARL corpus.
The target of identification is the source language.
Positive markers are evaluated for their power.
